script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

Title: FORGIVENESS IN THE METAVERSE

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

JAMES, a disgraced former scientist in his mid-40s, gazes at an ancient family photo. His wife, LUCY, and daughter, OLIVIA, smile back at him. He's haunted by the memory of an experiment gone wrong, which led to Olivia's death.

JAMES (V.O.)
I've spent every day since Olivia's death asking myself, "What if?"

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

James walks through the bustling metropolis, surrounded by holograms and flying vehicles. He's approached by MAYA, a fellow scientist and old friend.

MAYA
James, I've heard about your past tragedy. I'm here to help you.

INT. JAMES' LAB - DAY

James brings Maya up to speed on his failed experiment.

JAMES
I've been trying to recreate it, to make amends for my mistakes.

MAYA
James, your obsession is misplaced. You can't change the past. But you can make a difference in the future.

INT. METAVERSE HQ - DAY

James and Maya enter the headquarters of the Metaverse, a virtual reality platform designed for personal growth and learning. They meet with ZOE, the founder.

ZOE
Welcome, James and Maya. We've developed a unique program that can bring the deceased back into our lives through virtual interactions. Would you be interested?

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

James returns home, deep in thought. He decides to give the Metaverse a try.

INT. METAVERSE - DAY

James enters the Metaverse for the first time, finding himself in a beautiful virtual world. He's greeted by OLIVIA's hologram.

OLIVIA (V.O.)
Dad? Is that you?

JAMES
Yes, Olivia. It's really me.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY (REAL WORLD)

Lucy enters the room, surprised to find James sitting in front of the empty photo frame, tears streaming down his face.

LUCY
What's going on, James?

JAMES
Lucy, I've done something incredible. I've found a way to speak with Olivia again.

INT. METAVERSE - DAY

James and Olivia converse, apologizing to each other for the past and forgiving one another. They share precious moments that they missed due to James' obsession with his experiment.

INT. METAVERSE HQ - DAY

Zoe watches James and Olivia's interaction with awe.

ZOE
The power of forgiveness truly knows no bounds.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James and Lucy share a heartfelt moment, grateful for the forgiveness they have found in the Metaverse.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
